assumptions: Holm family = the contrasts of one family on one evaluation set, both levels (m counts the contrasts that exist on that set); sets are never pooled

families follow section 4 with D69 applied: confirmatory (FILTER-BM25 against RAW and against the subsample), then SweRankEmbed-Small, then WEIGHT and CURRICULUM, then the injected calibration cells; all but the first are exploratory

the interval a verdict is read from is the Holm-adjusted cluster-robust t interval of the contrast's own family (D136); the uncorrected t interval and the percentile bootstrap intervals are reported beside it
the L3 leave-largest-repository-out check (rule 3) compares the sign of the point estimate
arms separate (D80, rule 7) iff FILTER-BM25 against RAW is positive on every final set that has both levels, and at least one does; exploratory contrasts never decide the fallback
the indistinguishable flag (rule 4) is |difference| below the pooled seed SD of the two cells
